mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT MAX(r.id) FROM slm_revision r JOIN slm_law l ON l.id=r.tracked_law_id WHERE l.is_active=1 AND r.review_status='미검토') AS "latestUnreviewedId", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_law WHERE is_active=1) AS "trackedLawCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_document) AS "documentCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_law l WHERE l.is_active=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM slm_mapping m WHERE m.tracked_law_id=l.id)) AS "unmappedLawCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_revision r JOIN slm_law l ON l.id=r.tracked_law_id WHERE l.is_active=1 AND r.review_status='미검토') AS "unreviewedCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_revision r JOIN slm_law l ON l.id=r.tracked_law_id WHERE l.is_active=1 AND r.review_status='검토중') AS "inReviewCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slm_revision r JOIN slm_law l ON l.id=r.tracked_law_id WHERE l.is_active=1 AND r.review_status='반영완료') AS "reflectedCount", (SELECT MAX(last_synced_at) FROM slm_law WHERE is_active=1) AS "lastSyncAt" FROM dual
